# Make it Squeaky

> Residential cleaning in Toronto, run by Tiffany. Over a decade of professional cleaning experience, one set of hands on every job — no crews, no subcontractors. Regular, deep, move-in/move-out, and post-renovation cleaning, priced instantly from square footage.

Service area: City of Toronto (every postal code starting with M) at no travel fee. Travel fees beyond it: inner GTA $35 (postal codes starting L3, L4 or L5); outer GTA $60 (L1, L6 or L7). The fee is derived from the postal code and added after the minimum job price, never absorbed by it.

Services and rates, per square foot, CAD: Regular Cleaning $0.25 (half-day); Deep Cleaning $0.40 (full-day); Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning $0.65 (full-day); Post-Renovation Cleaning $0.75 (full-day). Quoted by approximate square footage, or estimated from home type, bedrooms and bathrooms if the exact figure isn't known. Minimum job price $180 — small jobs are floored at the minimum, not billed at the raw rate.

Add-ons: inside oven $50 and inside refrigerator $50 are fixed. Interior windows are $10 per window. Inside cabinets and drawers and wall washing start from $75 each, and inside kitchen appliances start from $25 per appliance — those three are starting prices, confirmed after a look. Heavy grime or excessive buildup, heavy pet hair, and heavy construction residue are not priced automatically; Tiffany confirms these in person so the price is right the first time.

No online payment in this phase — quotes are followed up by phone or message. No deposit is taken today and there is no cancellation charge today; a 50% deposit for full-day services and a 48-hour cancellation window take effect only when online booking opens.

Contact: phone/text +1 (416) 564-2125, email tiffanypoerazoff10@gmail.com.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://makeitsqueaky.com/): Overview of the business, service list, and the fastest path to a quote.
- [Get Your Price](https://makeitsqueaky.com/quote.html): Instant quote calculator — service type, postal code, square footage (or a bedroom/bathroom estimate), add-ons, and a few condition questions produce a live price.
- [Pricing](https://makeitsqueaky.com/pricing.html): What's included in each of the four cleaning types and the per-square-foot rate for each, then add-on prices, the minimum job, and travel fees.
- [About](https://makeitsqueaky.com/about.html): Background on Tiffany and how the business operates.
- [Contact](https://makeitsqueaky.com/contact.html): Phone number and a link to start a quote online.
- [Policies](https://makeitsqueaky.com/policies.html): Deposit, cancellation, service area, and standard-clean scope.

## Data

- [Rate card (JSON)](https://makeitsqueaky.com/data/pricing.json): The machine-readable source every published price on the site is checked against — rates, add-ons, minimum, travel zones by postal prefix, and the square-footage estimator.
